verdict.rationale: Error tracking is a SaaS product category that could reasonably ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a Rollbar CLI. Several nearby items do not count: the REST API and OpenAPI spec are developer building blocks, the stdio MCP server belongs to a separate story, the Terraform provider is a different tool, and rollbar-agent is a background agent that forwards payloads from a file rather than an interactive command-line tool.
